about: Band powers kept by the UV-fraction scale cut (arXiv:2603.13031; a band is kept while |C_UV|/(|C_UV| + |C_IR|) < 0.05, C_IR from P(k) times a step at k_max/D(zbar_i)), intersected with the shipped mask, split into clustering autos and cross-bin pairs, with the cut computed on the linear-bias fiducial (kept_*_linear: the linear notebook's cache, chains/EXAMPLE_EVALUATE_FISHER_SCALE_CUTS.pkl, which run_cuts reproduces at its reference settings) and on the paper model's fiducial (kept_*_paper: b2 and bs2 on their calibrations, every other higher-order term zero). k_max [h/Mpc] is the z = 0 value of the per-bin cut. Written by make_scale_cut_fiducial_data.py in notes/scale_cut_fiducial_dependence/plots/, from the scale-cut fiducial study (cuts_fid.py: run_cuts of tests/studies/run_fisher_derivatives.py at its reference settings on the paper yamls EXAMPLE_EVALUATE1-4.yaml; score_fid.py: the model B notebook builder's scoring functions).
